responsibility: Declares DefaultResolver, the common AST visitor base for the Resolver2_0 Rust name-resolution pipeline. It inherits from AST::DefaultASTVisitor, stores a mutable NameResolutionContext reference, and defines the visitor surface used by TopLevel, Early, and Late passes, especially for nodes that introduce lexical ribs or require default recursive descent, so specialized resolvers can override only the node kinds where they perform collection, lookup, or mapping work.
same_name_distinction: Declares the DefaultResolver class, its visit override surface, and the shared NameResolutionContext member used by Resolver2_0 passes; the paired .cc file contains the concrete traversal and scope-entry implementations for those visits.
